title: Vintage Sleeveless Lace Sheer Empire Waist A-Line Wedding Dress
descriptionHtml:
Say "I do" with an elegant look everlasting with this dreamy tulle A-line wedding dress featuring a plunging neckline and a lace empire waist, sheer lavish layers, and a beautiful empire waist. This vintage-inspired sleeveless wedding dress exudes a sophisticated glamor, unique and unforgettable with its attention to detail and textures.


Fit: Please refer to Size Chart.


Length: Floor Length.


Sleeve Style: Sleeveless.


Closure: It is Concealed a Zipper Up The Back.


Undergarments: It is Padded, with Lining.


Fabric: The garment comprises tulle.


Stretch: Fabric is Low Stretch.


Occasion: summer wedding, hot weather wedding, year round wedding, young wedding dress, youthful wedding dress, mature wedding dress
